previews.title: Prender3D
previews.caption_en: Low native supports touch measured fixed walls while the socket remains clear.
previews.caption_pt_br: Apoios nativos baixos tocam a parede fixa medida e preservam o encaixe.
previews.alt: Synthetic concept diagram: Low native supports touch measured fixed walls while the socket remains clear.

previews.title: PrenderPolvo3D
previews.caption_en: Eight low side contacts and a small inner contact avoid the articulated joint spaces.
previews.caption_pt_br: Oito contatos laterais baixos e um apoio interno preservam os espaços das articulações.
previews.alt: Synthetic concept diagram: Eight low side contacts and a small inner contact avoid the articulated joint spaces.

previews.title: Analyze 3D geometry
previews.caption_en: Inspect positive-mesh sections, transforms and unresolved functional keepouts before modifying the project.
previews.caption_pt_br: Inspecione seções da malha positiva, transforms e regiões funcionais ainda não resolvidas antes de alterar o projeto.
previews.alt: Synthetic concept diagram: Inspect positive-mesh sections, transforms and unresolved functional keepouts before modifying the project.

previews.title: Custom footprint
previews.caption_en: Choose a measured contour, contact layout and height limit for native masks; no solid base is added.
previews.caption_pt_br: Escolha contorno, contatos e limite de altura para máscaras nativas; nenhuma base sólida é adicionada.
previews.alt: Synthetic concept diagram: Choose a measured contour, contact layout and height limit for native masks; no solid base is added.

previews.title: Burj priming tower
previews.caption_en: The prepass G-code determines layer/material needs. The tower stops at the last real colour change while taller models can continue.
previews.caption_pt_br: O G-code de pré-fatiamento determina camadas e materiais. A torre termina na última troca real de cor, enquanto modelos mais altos podem continuar.
previews.alt: Synthetic concept diagram: The prepass G-code determines layer/material needs. The tower stops at the last real colour change while taller models can continue.

previews.title: Raised relief / destacar relevo 3D
previews.caption_en: A reference-guided raised outline and its buried root. Concept only; no native slice or print test.
previews.caption_pt_br: Contorno elevado guiado por referência e sua raiz embutida. Conceito sem fatiamento nativo nem teste físico.
previews.alt: Synthetic concept: flat part versus raised outline, buried root and material-priority checks.
